$comment: Theme slots: named, swappable micro-interactions a theme pack can replace (webviews/src/slots/registry.ts, docs/cmux-next/extensions/replace-a-slot.md). One entry per slot: its props contract, its motion spec in motion-scale tokens (never raw numbers), its reduced-motion behavior (required), the box every variant must fit (a variant never changes layout), the per-frame budget, and the variants cmux ships. The theme look selects a variant per slot (`slots: { "<slot id>": "<variant id>" }`); without it, or with an id no variant has, a slot draws its default. webviews `check:theme-slots` (scripts/check-theme-slots.ts) holds every variant to this file.

tokens.$comment: What a variant's stylesheet may name for a duration or an easing. Durations: the motion scale (schemas/motion-scale, `--cmux-motion-*`, `--cmux-spinner-period`) and the page loop periods beside it in pages/shared/desktop.css. Easings: the scale's curves, or `linear` / `steps(n)` for a loop.

budget.$comment: The rules every variant of every slot keeps. The check enforces each `enforced` rule on the variant's own files.

rules.rule: Keyframes and transitions change only `transform` and `opacity`: the compositor runs them, the page lays out and paints nothing per frame.

A variant's script starts no frame loop or timer (`requestAnimationFrame`, `setInterval`, `setTimeout`, Web Animations `animate()`, the page clock): all motion is CSS, so its main-thread cost per frame is zero by construction. Props the line already updates (its one-second clock) are the only change over time.
Every animation and transition duration is a `var()` of a duration token above and every easing an easing token or keyword: no `ms`/`s` literal anywhere in a variant's motion.

Every animation sits inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` and under the slot's motion gate, so Reduce Motion, static status indicators and animations off draw the variant's still frame.

No mark fades, blinks or pulses forever (an infinite loop whose keyframes move `opacity`, `visibility` or `scale`): a status mark is still, and a loop moves a mark from place to place instead. webviews test/no-breathing-dots.test.ts holds every shipped stylesheet to it.

A variant fits the slot's box (`box`): the same block size as the default, and an inline size that never changes while it runs. Swapping variants never moves the transcript. Reviewed in the gallery entry, whose layout-shift gate fails a variant that moves.
A loop stops with its condition (`stop`): the slot is drawn only while that holds, and a hidden page pauses every loop (`data-cmux-page-hidden`).

slots.title: Thinking indicator
slots.docs: The agent chat's live line while a turn thinks before it names a step: the word ("Thinking", or the rotating verb) and how it shows the agent is working. Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/Thinking.tsx inside the line's `<output>`; the line's clock, tokens and counts after it are not the slot's.

label.docs: The words to draw: "Thinking", the turn's rotating verb or the person's custom verb. Already translated.

verbs.docs: Every label the line may rotate through: reserve the widest (the default's `.cv-status-verb` grid does) so a verb change never moves what follows.

elapsed.docs: The time drawn after the slot ("12s"), when the line shows one; the default's light band crosses it too.

elapsedMs.docs: How long the turn has run, updated by the line's existing one-second clock. A variant may change its look past a threshold (more dots as thinking continues); it never starts its own timer.

box.block: The live line's one row (`.cv-worked`, `var(--grid-row)`): a variant draws inside the line's 20px line box and never grows it.
box.inline: The label at its reserved width (the widest of `verbs`) plus at most one mark of a fixed inline size, which never changes while the variant runs.

motion.reducedMotion: Every loop stops and the variant draws its still frame: the word in the line's muted tone and the mark (if any) at full strength, as the default draws the word with no band. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: The slot is drawn only while the turn thinks with no step named: the line changes to the call, "Writing" or the next state, or the turn ends, and the slot unmounts with its loops (the built-in default keeps its one band mounted through a named step: the live line draws it in place). A hidden page pauses it (`data-cmux-page-hidden`); the transcript unmounts rows outside its window.

variants.label: Shimmer
variants.docs: What the line drew before slots, unchanged: a light band in the theme accent sweeps across the dim word and the time. Its two loops are the shared shimmer (conversation.css `.cv-shimmer__*`, `cmux-shimmer-band`/`cmux-shimmer-lit` on `--cmux-shimmer-period`, transform only), which other running rows share, so its rules stay in conversation.css.

variants.label: Counting dots
variants.docs: Three dim dots after the word and a lit dot stepping from one to the next; past twenty seconds a fourth dot joins and the lit dot counts four, so a long think reads as longer.

variants.label: Pulse
variants.docs: One small round mark after the word swells in once as the think starts, then holds still.

variants.label: Caret
variants.docs: A thin caret after the word steps ahead a place at a time, as a cursor typing ahead of the next words; it never blinks.

variants.label: Blocks
variants.docs: Three square cells after the word, a lit block stepping across them a cell at a time: a retro look with no easing.

next.docs: The transcript's jump-to-latest button: how it appears, rests and leaves.
A sent prompt's arrival in the transcript (today `--cmux-motion-send`).
A reply's first words arriving under the live line.
The /side interaction: how a side question opens beside the thread and folds back.
A transcript row's hover: its fill and the actions it reveals.
